name: Metapod
description: It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.

moves.name: Harden
moves.description: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

moves.name: Electroweb
moves.description: The user attacks and captures opposing Pokémon using an electric net. This lowers their Speed stats.
